pages.title: Spent Fuel Rod
pages.text: A fuel rod after three years in a reactor: still mostly uranium, but laced with fission products a million times more radioactive.
Made in $(item)Irradiation Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Decay Chains.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Nuclear Waste Glass, Uranium-238 Pellet.
